extra_vocab.en: not required to pay or follow a rule that others must
extra_vocab.note: 這篇在談免收安裝費、免除罰款，exempt 是類似的概念：依規定，某人或某項目不用付費或不必遵守。常見於稅金、費用和規定。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 be exempt from + 名詞／V-ing，介系詞用 from，不用 of；當動詞時是 exempt A from B。

example.en: The new rule exempts small businesses from the filing fee.
example.zh: 新規定讓小型企業免繳申報費。

example.en: Nonprofit groups were exempted from the registration fee this year.
example.zh: 今年非營利團體免繳登記費。

example.en: Exempting early customers from the deposit may attract more orders.
example.zh: 讓早期客戶免付訂金，可能會吸引更多訂單。

example.en: Educational materials are exempt from tax in this region.
example.zh: 教育教材在這個地區免稅。

example.en: Members are exempt from the annual service fee.
example.zh: 會員免繳年度服務費。

example.en: The foundation is a tax-exempt organization that supports schools.
example.zh: 這個基金會是支持學校的免稅組織。

examples.en: Are existing customers exempt from the new fuel surcharge?
examples.zh: 現有客戶可以免收新的燃油附加費嗎？

examples.en: Employees in this department are exempt from the new policy.
examples.zh: 這個部門的員工不適用新政策。

examples.en: Medical supplies may be exempt from import duties.
examples.zh: 醫療用品可能免繳進口關稅。

confusable.diff: except 是「除了」，exempt 是「被免除的」，拼法相近。
confusable.usage: except 是介系詞，後面直接接名詞；exempt 是形容詞，常用 be exempt from。

example.en: All items are included except the installation fee.
example.zh: 除了安裝費以外，所有項目都包含在內。

similar.diff: waive 的主詞是收費的一方，主動放棄收取；exempt 是依規定讓某人不適用。

example.en: The bank will waive the fee for new accounts.
example.zh: 銀行會對新帳戶免收費用。

similar.diff: excused 多指被允許不用做某事，例如出席會議或工作，語氣較個人。

example.en: Staff are excused from the meeting if they are traveling.
example.zh: 出差中的員工可以不用參加會議。

example.en: The price does not include tax or delivery charges.
example.zh: 價格不含稅金和運費。

example.en: Import duty is added to goods from overseas.
example.zh: 來自海外的商品會加收進口關稅。

example.en: The new regulation applies to all companies in the city.
example.zh: 新規定適用於這個城市的所有公司。

derived.link: exempt + -ion，名詞字尾，把「免除」變成名詞，像 collect → collection

example.en: Orders over five hundred dollars are exempt from the shipping charge.
example.zh: 超過五百美元的訂單免收運費。

pos_uses.zh: 免除（某人的義務或費用）

example.en: The company decided to exempt long-term customers from the setup fee.
example.zh: 公司決定讓長期客戶免繳設定費。

extra_vocab.en: to think something is probably true, but you are not sure
extra_vocab.note: 男士用 I suspect 提出一個憑經驗的猜測：廠商可能會接受較低的費率。這裡不是「懷疑某人做壞事」，而是委婉、不確定的推測，用來提出議價的想法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: suspect + (that) 子句 表示「猜想」；suspect + 人 + of + 名詞／V-ing 才是「懷疑某人做了…」，例如 suspect him of fraud。

example.en: She suspects that the supplier will lower its prices soon.
example.zh: 她猜想供應商很快會降價。

example.en: We suspected the invoice contained an error, so we checked it.
example.zh: 我們懷疑發票有錯誤，所以檢查了一下。

example.en: Suspecting a billing error, she called the vendor right away.
example.zh: 她懷疑帳單有誤，立刻打電話給廠商。

example.en: I suspect that the delay was caused by bad weather.
example.zh: 我猜延誤是壞天氣造成的。

example.en: We suspect a problem with the new payment system.
example.zh: 我們懷疑新的付款系統有問題。

example.en: The bank suspects the customer of using a false identity.
example.zh: 銀行懷疑這位客戶使用假身分。

examples.en: I suspect our competitor will lower its prices next month.
examples.zh: 我猜我們的競爭對手下個月會降價。

examples.en: We suspect that your account has been used without permission.
examples.zh: 我們懷疑您的帳戶被未經許可使用。

examples.en: I suspect the shipment is late because of the storm.
examples.zh: 我猜這批貨延遲是因為暴風雨。

confusable.diff: expect 是合理地預期某事會發生；suspect 是憑直覺或線索猜測，沒有把握。

example.en: We expect the vendor to accept a lower rate.
example.zh: 我們預期廠商會接受較低的費率。

confusable.diff: inspect 是仔細檢查；suspect 是憑感覺猜想，兩者字尾相同，容易搞混。

example.en: Please inspect the equipment before you sign the delivery form.
example.zh: 簽收單據前，請先檢查設備。

similar.diff: assume 是把某件事當成事實先假設；suspect 則帶有「不太確定」的懷疑感。

example.en: I assume the contract includes free repairs for two years.
example.zh: 我假設合約包含兩年的免費維修。

similar.diff: guess 較口語，可以是隨便猜；suspect 通常有一些依據或經驗。

example.en: I guess they will agree if we offer a longer term.
example.zh: 我猜如果我們提出較長的期限，他們會同意。

example.en: I doubt the supplier will accept such a low price.
example.zh: 我懷疑供應商不會接受這麼低的價格。

example.en: I believe the contract can be renewed this week.
example.zh: 我相信合約這週可以續約。

derived.link: suspect 的名詞形，拼法稍有變化（-ect 換成 -icion），指「起疑」的感覺
suspicion 去掉 -ion 換成 -ious，變形容詞，像 delicious、serious

example.en: We suspect that some invoices were sent to the wrong address.
example.zh: 我們猜想有些發票寄到了錯誤的地址。

example.en: Police arrested a suspect in the office theft case.
example.zh: 警方逮捕了辦公室竊盜案的嫌疑人。

senses.en: to think something is probably true, but you are not sure

example.en: I suspect the new plan will cost more than expected.
example.zh: 我猜新方案會比預期花更多錢。

senses.en: to think a person has done something wrong
senses.distinguish: 看句型：suspect + 人 + of + 行為，才是懷疑某人；suspect + that 子句通常是中性的猜測。

example.en: The company suspects a former employee of leaking the plans.
example.zh: 公司懷疑一名前員工洩漏了計畫。
